changelog:
- Initial release of "insurance-renew-talking" skill.
- Converts user-supplied policy renewal dates and authorized stills into 2–8 short, individualized insurance renewal reminder talking clips.
- Insists on strict use of supplied schedule information; does not invent details or force renewals.
- Automated handling of voice and video creation flow, including clone, speech, and video stages with real-time credit and input checks.
- Clear routing/delegation to related skills for non-renewal talking video needs.
- Emphasizes secure consent, input collection, and separation of planning from execution.
summary: Turn user-supplied policy renewal dates and authorized stills into one insurance renewal reminder talking clip per still. This insurance renewal reminder talking video studio writes a speakable expiry-date talking clip for each photo, then animates a 2 to 15s renewal reminder talking clip. Use it for insurance renewal reminder talking packs that stay one photo, one clip.
